review_notes:
I read the whole file. It has no @[simp] attributes, no simp sets and no simp-normal-form claims, and the main proof uses rw, exact and rintro. The helper lemmas are one-off proof steps:
- exists_finite_subset_le_span and exists_finite_subset_image are existential statements, so they are not rewrite rules.
- homogeneousComponent_mul_left has an if-then-else on its right-hand side and a hypothesis hp. It would be a poor simp lemma because it would introduce a case split. Its only use is an explicit rw inside homogeneousComponent_mem_span.
- ker_ideal_fg_of_finitePresentation_app and finitePresentation_app_of_comp are existence or property lemmas, not rewrites.
- The repeated HomogeneousLocalization.mk / awayToSection expression in the theorem statement and in hset could be factored out. That is a duplication issue, not a simp-interface issue, so I did not report it under this rubric.
I did not search Mathlib for a lemma that duplicates homogeneousComponent_mul_left, because adding a simp lemma there would not be justified anyway. I have no evidence of a missing canonical simp lemma, a wrong orientation, competing rules or a rewrite cycle.
